events.title: Japanese Market Notably Lower
events.description: The Japanese stock market is trading notably lower on Tuesday, extending the sharp losses in the previous session, following the broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight, with the Nikkei 225 falling below the 59,300 level, with weakness in across most sectors led by automakers, exporters and financial stocks.

events.title: Lower Open Called For Indonesia Stock Market
events.description: The Indonesia stock market on Monday ended the two-day winning streak in which it had rallied almost 230 points or 4.5 percent. The Jakarta Composite Index now sits just beneath the 5,320-point plateau and it's likely to open under water again on Tuesday.

events.title: Hong Kong Stock Market May Hand Back Monday's Gains
events.description: The Hong Kong stock market on Monday halted the three-day losing streak in which it had stumbled almost 925 points or 3.9 percent. The Hang Seng now sits just above the 23,750-point plateau although it may head south again on Tuesday.

events.title: Australian Markets Sharply Lower
events.description: The Australian stock market is sharply lower on Tuesday, extending the losses in the previous three sessions, following the broadly negative cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 index is falling well below the 8,950 level, with weakness across most sectors led by mining and financial stocks.

events.title: China Stock Market May Give Up Support At 3,600 Points
events.description: The China stock market has finished lower in three straight sessions, retreating almost 80 points or 2.2 percent in that span. The Shanghai Composite Index now sits just above the 3,600-point plateau and it may take further damage again on Tuesday.

events.title: Oversold Taiwan Stock Market Tipped To Open In The Red
events.description: The Taiwan stock market has finished lower in two three trading days since the end of the three-day winning streak in which it had rallied almost 3,550 points or 8.6 percent. The Taiwan Stock Exchange now sits just above the 41,040-point plateau although it may open under pressure again on Tuesday.

events.title: Losing Streak May Continue For Singapore Stock Market
events.description: The Singapore stock market has moved lower in three straight sessions, retreating more than 100 points or 2 percent along the way. The Straits Times Index now sits just above the 5,180-point plateau and it may spin its wheels again on Tuesday.

events.title: Malaysia Stock Market May Turn Lower Again On Tuesday.
events.description: The Malaysia stock market on Monday halted the five-day losing streak in which it had dropped more than 55 points or 3.3 percent. The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index now sits just beneath the 1,590-point plateau although it may hand those gains back on Tuesday.

events.title: Japan Stock Market May See Continued Consolidation
events.description: The Japan stock market has finished lower in two of three trading days since the end of the three-day winning streak in which it had jumped almost 3,800 points or 5 percent. The Nikkei 225 now sits just above the 59,660-point plateau and it's likely to extend those losses on Tuesday.

events.title: Lingering Tech Weakness May Weigh On KOSPI
events.description: The South Korea stock market has finished lower in three straight sessions, slumping almost 275 points or 5.2 percent along the way. The KOSPI now sits just above the 5,100-point plateau and it may remain stuck in neutral on Tuesday.

events.title: RBA Minutes On Tap For Tuesday
events.description: The Reserve Bank of Australia will on Tuesday release the minutes from its November 2 meeting, highlighting a modest day for Asia-Pacific economic activity.

events.title: U.S. Dollar Inches Higher As Fed Rate Hike Expectations Continue To Increase
events.description: The U.S. Dollar value moved higher on Monday as investors priced in rate hikes by the U.S. Federal Reserve while a sharp decline in crude oil prices due to surplus production forecasts limited the gains.

events.title: SMI Rises 0.57% As Richemont Earnings Boost Market Sentiment
events.description: Switzerland's SMI benchmark index rose 86.46 points to 15,192.58 on Monday, driven by Richemont's 2.7% climb following first-half earnings of EUR2.528 billion, up from EUR1.813 billion last year. Revenue increased 15.7% to EUR12.282 billion.
